name: Mijad Private Data Center / Sham Cloud
notes: SANA official report (Syria HiTech 12, Damascus): Mijad Technical Services operates a private data center in Damascus providing cloud infrastructure (Sham Cloud) to Damascus University students and enterprises; tripartite MoU with CanaGulf and Uptime Institute representation to qualify Syrian data centers to international standards. Strongest current private-sector DC lead; Uptime certification itself NOT yet verified on the official certification list; capacity/site address not published.

name: Ministry of Higher Education IT Center (COMSATS-COMSTECH)
developer: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research / COMSATS
notes: SANA: minister opened the COMSATS-COMSTECH information technology center in Damascus (est. 2000) with new technical equipment; center manages a data center and hosting services and runs university admissions e-systems. Government/education hosting facility (public-sector function, A-grade), not confirmed commercial colocation.

name: Digital Syria National Data Center
developer: MOCT (Ministry of Communications and Information Technology)
notes: A-grade program-level lead: strategic initiative to build complete infrastructure for secure collection/storage/management of national data; MOCT responsible entity, G2G beneficiaries. No governorate/site address/MW/racks/operator/opening date published - record as program-level/planned, not an operational facility.

name: Go (Etihad Atheeb) National Data Center MoU
notes: Non-binding MoU with the Syrian government to help provide a national data center, digital government services, AI/IoT adoption and cloud computing; facility details (site, land, capacity, construction) not published. Keep as MoU/announced per methodology; not a datacenter facility yet.

name: SilkLink Program - data centers component (STC)
developer: STC Group (75% stake, ~USD 800M) / Syrian Telecom / Syrian Sovereign Fund
notes: STC won the SilkLink bid: 4,500km fiber backbone (ITU-T G.652/G.655), several data centers, international submarine cable landing station in Tartous, five IXPs (Damascus, Aleppo, Tartous, Palmyra, Qamishli), 10Tbps initial/25Tbps future capacity. Program-level A (SPA release + MOCT RFI) with B build details (DCD). No specific DC facility sites/owners named yet - program-level/connectivity, not operational DCs.

name: SilkLink IXP - Aleppo (planned)
notes: One of five planned SilkLink internet exchange points (connectivity/program-level per official RFI). Not a datacenter facility; no colocation/meet-me room evidence yet. No other Aleppo datacenter evidence found in web sweep.

name: SilkLink IXP - Palmyra/Tadmur (planned)
notes: One of five planned SilkLink internet exchange points (connectivity/program-level per official RFI). Not a datacenter facility. No Homs/Hassia/Palmyra datacenter evidence found in web sweep.

name: SilkLink IXP - Qamishli (planned)
notes: One of five planned SilkLink internet exchange points (connectivity/program-level per official RFI). Not a datacenter facility. No Hasaka/Qamishli datacenter evidence found in web sweep.

name: Medusa Submarine Cable - Tartous Landing Station
developer: Medusa Submarine Cable System / Syrian Telecom
notes: Cable landing agreement signed in Tartous under MOCT auspices (connectivity/landing station lead, not a datacenter). No hosting/colo service evidence published.

name: Ugarit 2 Submarine Cable - Tartous Landing
notes: Repeaterless 240km, 24 fibre-pair cable between Pentaskhinos (Cyprus) and Tartous; landing facilities operated by Syrian Telecom and CYTA; RFS targeted early 2028. Connectivity/landing-station lead, not a datacenter.

name: SilkLink International Submarine Cable Landing Station - Tartous (planned)
notes: SilkLink project includes an international submarine cable landing station in Tartous (connectivity/program-level). Not a datacenter facility.

name: Hyperscaler cloud region - negative sweep
notes: A-grade negative evidence: AWS/Azure/GCP/Oracle Cloud official region lists contain no Syria region as of 2026-08-12. Provider partnership statements are aspirational unless an official region announcement names Syria.
